title: ProofFlowInferenceOutput
description: Structured output schema for ProofFlow freelance deliverable evaluation

overall_score.description: Evidence-grounded aggregate evaluation score on a 0-100 scale, or null if evidence is insufficient

dimension_scores.description: Component scores for actively evaluated dimensions only

evidence_coverage.description: Measurable proportion of criteria and rubric dimensions supported by actual evidence

missing_requirements.description: List of explicit or inferred requirements not demonstrated or known to be unmet

improvement_suggestions.description: Actionable recommendations for improving deliverable satisfaction

confidence.description: Calibrated uncertainty/confidence metric based on evidence availability

evaluation_method.description: Combination of models, rules, validation evidence, and adapters employed

limitations.description: Explicit constraints, omitted dimensions, or missing inputs identified during evaluation
